New #WJDS paper: Why can't computers chat yet?

Revisiting #ELIZA, Lucy Suchman argues that the differences between humans and machines persist. Mutual intelligibility is co-constructed in open worlds and can't be reduced to digital input. The aim: demystify computation and foreground the human agencies behind it.
